tldr: The Sun in Pisces: identity built through compassion, imagination, and spiritual sensitivity.
body: With the Sun in Pisces, the core self strengthens through empathy, creativity, intuition, and connection to what cannot be measured. You are here to keep your heart open while still staying embodied.
gift: Compassion, artistry, intuition, forgiveness, and imaginative wisdom.
challenge: Escapism, blurred boundaries, and disappearing into others' needs.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
